<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_InventoryReorder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-reorder">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReorder" name="Inventory Reordering and Restocking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Process begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Stock at predefined threshold?" default="Flow_ThresholdNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert signals need to reorder"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Manual check signals need to reorder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Reorder need signaled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Procurement team places order with suppliers, considering cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received">
      <bpmn:人oneEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock for quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageChoice" name="Choose stock placement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageMerge" name="Stock placement complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Inventory levels updated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_SignalChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock level reaches predefined threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNotReached" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalMerge_Order" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateExpected" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateExpected_StockReceived" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Event_StockReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockReceived_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_StorageChoice" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_StorageChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Storage_Shelves" name="Place on shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Storage_Store" name="Place in storage" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelves_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Store_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StorageMerge_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalChoice" name="How is the need to reorder signaled?"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
